user.title: Client Entity Filter
user.description: Choose which entities are held back from dashboards and apps. The entities keep working for automations, history and everything else on the server; filtered clients just don't receive their states. A filtered client shows such an entity as not found.

data.keep_globs: Entity ID patterns to keep (dashboards mode)
data.exclude_globs: Entity ID patterns to hold back

data_description.users: Only connections of these users are filtered. Leave empty to filter every user.
data_description.clients: Use the mobile apps option to keep the browser on your computer unfiltered while the same user is filtered on the phone.
data_description.mode: Rules: everything is sent except what the rules below hold back. Dashboards: only the entities your dashboards and the energy dashboard use are sent, plus what you keep below; the rules then also hold back entities that are on a dashboard.
data_description.keep_domains: Always sent in full, for example `person` or `binary_sensor`. Needed for cards that pick their entities themselves, such as auto-entities.
data_description.keep_entities: Always sent, in both modes, even if a rule below matches them.
data_description.exclude_labels: Entities with one of these labels, and all entities of devices with one of these labels.
data_description.exclude_domains: All entities of these domains, for example `update`.
data_description.exclude_globs: Patterns with * as a wildcard, for example `sensor.battery*_cell_*`.
data_description.exclude_hidden: Entities that are hidden in their settings.
data_description.exclude_categories: Entities an integration marked as diagnostic or configuration.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration is possible.

init.title: Client Entity Filter
init.description: With the saved settings, {excluded} of {total} entities are held back from filtered clients. Changes apply the next time a client connects, for example after reloading the page or restarting the app.
